points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in autonomous marketing agent workflows.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for ad optimization engines.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring reliable decisions by autonomous agents.
\item Introduced batched query extraction, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling faster, reliable operational inference.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for campaign workflows, reducing redundant checks by 25%, improving user experience while maintaining performance integrity.
